name: Zhejiang Yongtai Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Yongtai Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of fluorinated pharmaceuticals, crop science, and new energy materials in China and internationally. Its products include fluorinated polymers, fluorinated fine chemicals, refrigerants, foaming agents, fire extinguishers, etc. The company also trades in herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and other pesticide active ingredients and formulations; and lithium carbonate.
